function: p. 7: learned UAV communication and sensing beamforming, jointly with trajectory, computation allocation, target scheduling and NN layer split, to maximize the group-target sensing completion rate.
system: p. 3, 10: UAVs with 8-antenna ULAs, single-antenna users, J targets, one satellite; no RIS; wavelength 0.125 m (about 2.4 GHz), 20 MHz bandwidth.
method: p. 7-9: collaborative multi-agent DDPG, centralized training and decentralized execution, shared critic parameters, action mask; reinforcement learning in simulation.
data_channel: p. 4: custom simulator, free-space model for UAV-satellite link and probabilistic LoS/NLoS model with Gaussian NLoS fading for UAV-ground; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurements.
test_conditions: p. 10-12: same simulator for training and testing; sweeps over disabled UAVs, targets, UAV count and computation capacity; no unseen scenario; retraining per setting not stated.
baselines: p. 10: non-learned: average split, greedy, K-Means trajectory, straight-line trajectory; learned variants: independent MA-DDPG, MA-DDPG without mask; MA-PPO only in the convergence plot (p. 11).
metrics: p. 6, 11-13: GTST completion rate (share of NN layers inferred successfully); sum reward per episode; sensed targets and group-target center and speed estimates.
complexity: p. 9-10: order of complexity of training and execution (execution O(Ds Da)), contrasted with convex optimization complexity; no measured runtime.
q1_support: p. 4: "The free propagation model is taken to describe the channel for the U2S link"; the U2G link uses a probabilistic LoS model (p. 4). No 3GPP TR 38.901 or 38.811, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 14: "the maximum number of UAVs is defined in the training phase"; Figs. 6-9 (p. 11-12) sweep disabled UAVs, targets, UAVs and computation capacity with no statement of training on other values. The claim on p. 14, "no need to retrain the model in the execution", is not tested.
q3_support: p. 10: "The independent MA-DDPG (IMA-DDPG) scheme: Agents adopt decentralized training (DT) and DE." This is the proposed method trained another way, and WMOS is an ablation. Non-learned baselines exist, but MA-PPO appears only in the convergence plot (p. 11), so no earlier learned method is compared on the completion rate.
q4_support: p. 9: "In the execution phase, the complexity is written as" O(Ds Da); the training complexity is also given as an order expression (p. 9).
q5_support: p. 10: "we use Python and PyTorch for simulation"; no code or data link is given and the data come from the paper's own simulator (Table II lists parameters only).
notes: Included: the DRL agents output communication and sensing beamforming vectors (p. 7-8) jointly with trajectory and computation allocation, so above_phy does not exclude it. Area 6 chosen over 5 by the tie-break (aerial and satellite links that also sense); area 5 also fits. IMA-DDPG is the same method with decentralized training and WMOS an ablation, hence q3=0. The paper claims no retraining is needed for any number of UAVs (p. 14) but shows no such test, hence q2=0.
